name.value: Pho Boi A Taste of Vietnam

description.value: Phở Bội is a Vietnamese restaurant in Nanaimo serving a broad menu of traditional pho, vermicelli bowls, and appetizers rooted in the five-taste profile of Vietnamese cuisine. The restaurant emphasizes fresh ingredients, herbs, and vegetables, offering both hearty beef-broth noodle soups and lighter options. It is a sit-down neighbourhood restaurant with an extensive menu that could satisfy a hungry touring cyclist looking for a filling, flavourful meal.

address.value: Unit 108 - 6596 Applecross Road, Nanaimo, BC V9V 0A4

raw_osm.name: Pho Boi A Taste of Vietnam

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content at phoboi.ca confirms the restaurant's address (unit 108 - 6596 Applecross Road, Nanaimo, B.C. V9V 0A4) and phone number ((250) 933-0071), corroborating OSM tags. The menu page explicitly lists 'Phở Chay Vegetable' and a tofu curry option, confirming vegetarian/vegan-friendly items. No mention of bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, takeout, or other cyclist amenities appears anywhere on the site; these are all null. The website header reads '...Vietnamese Restaurant | Victoria' which conflicts with the Nanaimo location confirmed on the contact page and in OSM — flagged as a concern. The about and testimonials pages contain placeholder/template text, suggesting the site is partially built out.
concerns: Website page title/header reads 'Vietnamese Restaurant | Victoria' but the contact page and OSM both place the restaurant in Nanaimo — possible stale or template text on the site.
About page and testimonials section contain Wix/website-builder placeholder text ('Click here to add your own text'), indicating the site is partially built out and some content may be unreliable.
Online ordering page says 'COMING SOON!!' — the ORDER ONLINE navigation item may mislead customers.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A real, open Vietnamese restaurant at a confirmed Nanaimo address with a functioning website and phone number. Suitable inclusion for the directory as a dining option for touring cyclists.
